integrity: The finite certificates are enumerative, acyclic discrete-Morse matchings with exact integral unit-pivot cancellation. The standard CW attaching-map argument supplies the homotopy step. Executable verification is reproducible but not independent expert certification.
scientific_limitations: The three even board sizes 2, 4 and 6 are classified individually; the first-even mixed-dimensional threshold is confined to that exact finite range. No formula for higher even or odd board sizes, nor a periodic-board claim, is asserted. Literature equivalence risk remains.
title: A mixed-dimensional homotopy transition in even-board bishop complexes
